assets.gate_reason: Reviewer rejected first Daikara wall as fragmented shrub-like peaks with visible floor. This new design uses a broad raised rock slab; all 16 neighbor masks will be rebuilt without an edge waiver.
assets.scope: Daikara DEFAULT and VOLCANO levels 1–4, including VOLCANO L4 Caldera.

references.note: Accepted KorPul wall reads as a contiguous blocking mass across neighboring cells; use its broad planar visual weight, not its masonry blocks.

grid_contract.export: Native-alpha solid central cliff block with at least 3% source margin; exporter builds continuous 16-way rock connections from its material, no waiver.

prompt_fields.subject: A SINGLE massive raised mountain-rock slab or cliff block, not an arrangement of stones. One broad continuous flat-ish slate top face and one thick, dark, near-vertical front face, with only a few large planar fractures. It is an impassable, sight-blocking rock mass.
prompt_fields.palette: Muted blue-charcoal and gray-brown basaltic stone, restrained cold light on upper-left top plane; dark but readable side face. No snow.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as one heavy solid boulder block occupying most of its square cell, clearly unlike snowy trees, separate rocks, shrubs, or floor. No thin upright spikes, foliage, rubble, holes, or floor visible between parts of the block.
prompt_fields.composition: One nearly square, wide and tall coherent mass in overhead three-quarter tabletop view. Broad upper rim around 15% from image top, bottom rock face around 10% from image bottom. Solid footprint around 85-90% of canvas width and 75-85% height. COMPLETE shape inside canvas with at least 3% genuinely transparent inset on all four sides and transparent corners. No cut-off rock. Exporter will extend the rock material to connected cell edges.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Diggable MOUNTAIN_WALL; blocks movement and line of sight. No danger symbols, lava, snow, door, or character.

assets.gate_reason: Reviewer rejected first lava as reddish dirt. New design is charcoal basalt crust with sparse faint warm fissures; Daikara LAVA_FLOOR remains harmless.
assets.scope: Daikara DEFAULT and VOLCANO levels 1–4, including VOLCANO L4 Caldera.

references.note: Native Daikara lava is dark mottled, passable and harmless after zone callback.
Accepted flat board material scale and upper-left lighting, not its snowy palette.

grid_contract.danger: No on_stand callback in Daikara; harmless.
grid_contract.interaction: Caldera down exit may be assigned onto this floor.
grid_contract.export: Opaque lava surface with parity and seams added by exporter.

prompt_fields.subject: Overhead dormant cooled lava surface: large dark charcoal basalt crust plates, their boundaries defined by a few thin, irregular, almost black fissures with an occasional faint deep ember-red glint far inside. Hard vitrified crust, not earth, gravel, soil, or pebbles.
prompt_fields.palette: Predominantly dark neutral charcoal and cool slate, subtle muted brown undertone; tiny sparse deep dull red-orange accents occupying under 3% of surface.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels, basalt plates and fine fractures distinguish this from reddish dirt and gray bare-rock floor. It must feel safely cooled and walkable, with no alarming bright glow.
prompt_fields.composition: Flat overhead seamless-looking edge-to-edge matte ground texture, low relief, no seams, objects, symbols, flames, molten pools, bright orange/yellow cracks, or hazard marks.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Daikara LAVA_FLOOR is passable and harmless; subdued thermal history only, no injury warning.
